mechanism: Both drugs can cause CNS toxicity and seizures; foscarnet causes seizures through electrolyte abnormalities and direct neurotoxicity while mefloquine is associated with neuropsychiatric adverse effects, creating additive CNS risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor closely for seizures, neuropsychiatric symptoms, and electrolyte abnormalities; maintain adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
